agent_explanation: Body 0 starts 0.1m from wall 0 (wall x=5.5 w=0.2, body x=6.3 r=0.5) with speed ~55.6 m/s and dt=0.0319 => displacement ~1.77m, much larger than wall thickness 0.2m and initial clearance. Even with 60 substeps (substep ~0.53ms, travel ~0.03m per substep still less than wall but CCD logic appears to miss centre crossing through thin axis-aligned box). Body centre goes from x=6.3 to x=5.242, y 3.4 to 1.97, ending on opposite side of wall with centre-inside-box traversal between steps 0 and 1. Reducing dt to 0.001 makes displacement ~0.055m, no tunneling, confirming cause is inadequate continuous collision detection for high-speed traversal of thin wall at large dt.
